result:
The continuation of T-DG6-BE-E is done, and all four acceptance checks pass on the final tree. The salvaged work had one real defect, which I fixed. The changes are uncommitted on top of the salvage commit `5a9887f`.

**The defect.** The new default `upload` rate limit of 30 per minute per user throttled an existing suite. `media-types.test.ts` uploads more than 30 times a minute as one user, so 4 of its 21 tests got `429 rate_limited`. The shared test setup in `apps/api/test/support/harness.ts` raised the global and sign-in limits for tests but not the new class limits. I added the five class limits there at 100000, and production defaults are unchanged. `harness.ts` is a shared file outside my listed files; the handback flags it for you.

I also changed `admin/security.test.ts`, the only other code change. Its API now starts with five distinct class limits, so the test still proves each class reports its own configured value.

**The original run's evidence was not clean.** Its locale-unset `pnpm test` log ends with exit 1, caused by a Vitest timeout error rather than a failed test. Its C.UTF-8 log is cut off, and no integration run was ever done. I kept those logs as its record. Every result below comes from the new `eb-*.log` files.

| Check | Exit | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `validate --historical --stage DG5` (start and end) | 0 | PASS |
| `pnpm -r typecheck` | 0 | |
| `pnpm -r build` | 0 | |
| `pnpm lint` | 0 | |
| prettier check of all tracked and new files | 0 | |
| `pnpm openapi:lint` | 0 | 876 operations |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset and `C.UTF-8` | 0 / 0 | same counts both times: 2413, 1746 and 259 passed (2 existing skips in the formula fuzz test) |
| `pnpm test:integration` on the final tree (ports 23860–23899) | 0 | 324/324 files; 3135 passed, 1 skipped, 1 todo |

- **Earlier integration runs:**
  - Run 1 exited 1: it found the 4 throttled failures, and its tree was partly fixed mid-run.
  - Run 2 exited 1 when a Vitest worker crashed while lint and typecheck ran beside it. That was not a test failure; the cause was most likely memory, but I couldn't confirm it.
  - A targeted run of the four affected files then passed.
- **Unit tests:** both `pnpm test` runs were done before the two test-file changes. Those files are outside every unit project's include globs, so the results still apply.
- **e2e:** the e2e specs upload only twice in total, far under the default limit, so I left their stack scripts alone. I did not run the e2e suite.
- **Time:** about 2 h 7 min, past the 2-hour limit. The extra time went to the required full integration run.

**Pending list, contract and texts:** no further change.
- **Pending list:** `getSecurityRateLimits`, `listAuditEvents` and `getAuditEvent` were already removed (3 → 0), and each is exercised in `p6-exercises-be-e.ts`.
- **Contract test:** its pinned counts are unchanged (101 tests passed).
- **Migrations, endpoints, dependencies:** no migration (no id taken), no new endpoint and no new dependency.
- **User-facing texts:** none made untrue.

**What remains:**
- Once BE-B lands, swap the temporary redaction rule for its sensitivity check. Today every sensitive record's audit events are redacted for everyone. Then turn the `it.todo` for an admitted caller into a real test.
- The owner of the export routes still has to put them in the `export` rate-limit class.
- Not mine but needed: regenerate `.env.example` (DO-A), document the new variables in `configuration.md` (devops), and add the worker's secret-provider line.
- BE-E2's security suite is still to come.

Everything is in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/`: the updated handback `T-DG6-BE-E-backend-workflow-engineer.md` (continuation changes marked [EB]) and the new logs (`eb-*.log`) in `T-DG6-BE-E-evidence/`.
